text:
Sasha (Growth): quick kickoff for NebulaCloud listing + joint webinar + companion benchmark blog. need to lock inbound routing so Sales gets demo-ready leads. who can own end-to-end?
Liam (PMM): I can run webinar narrative + benchmark writeup. targeting mid-July. want clear UTM naming and a shared registration form. :spiral_calendar:
Noor (Partnerships): Ill own partner asset handoff and timeline. NebulaCloud requires a logo cert, two screenshots, a short partner blurb and three feature bullets. can request assets today.
Ivy (Content): I need assets by Jun 30 to draft landing + co-auth blog. will ask for a 300-500 word guest section from partner PM and a one-line customer quote.
Owen (Sales Ops): routing preference: form -> webhook -> SFDC lead creation with partner=nebulacloud and lead_source=partner_webinar. need immediate Slack ping to #inbound-alerts for high-intent leads. provide sample payload?
Owen (Sales Ops): ```json
{
  "webhook": "https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-ingest",
  "payload": {
    "email": "{{email}}",
    "name": "{{full_name}}",
    "company": "{{company_name}}",
    "title": "{{job_title}}",
    "company_size": "{{company_size}}",
    "primary_use_case": "{{primary_use_case}}",
    "intent_level": "{{intent_level}}",
    "utm_source": "nebulacloud",
    "utm_campaign": "nebulacloud_july_webinar",
    "partner_tag": "nebulacloud"
  }
}```
Sasha (Growth): Noor can you confirm partner will surface company_size & primary_use_case when registrants use our form?
Noor (Partnerships): Yes, theyre fine with our form. they wont provide a CSV.
Ivy (Content): landing will include hidden utm fields, partner_tag, and a one-question micro-survey: "Primary use case (select)" for routing. also add GDPR consent checkbox for EU users.
Sam (Legal): flag: need written logo permission and quote signoff. also want to pre-review any benchmarking claims. Noor, please get the logo agreement and quote approval by Jun 18.
Liam (PMM): benchmark plan: small internal test showing cost-per-1M-embedding-ops and median latency for retrieval across shared vs dedicated. aim to surface 1 headline stat + a chart for the blog. Ivy, can you include a 2-paragraph highlight and chart?
Ivy (Content): yes. Liam send the minimal CSV by Jun 20.
Owen (Sales Ops): SDR routing rules: if intent_level=="high" -> create SFDC lead + post to #inbound-alerts with: "Hot Lead (NebulaCloud): <name> - <company> - <title> - <primary_use_case> - <lead link>". if intent==medium -> assign to partner SDR queue.
Sasha (Growth): checklist with owners: 1) Landing + hidden fields - Ivy (Jun 30) 2) Webhook payload & SFDC mapping - Owen (Jul 7) 3) Partner assets + logo agreement - Noor (Jun 18) 4) Legal approvals - Sam (Jun 20) 5) Benchmark data - Liam (Jun 20) 6) Webinar promotion cadence - Sasha/Liam (Jul 6) 7) Post-webinar nurture - Sasha (Jul 20).
Noor (Partnerships): will share partner timeline and request assets today.
ProjBot: Reminder: Webinar event created for 2026-07-15 16:00 UTC. Attendees: Marketing, Sales Ops, Partnerships. :robot_face:
Sam (Legal): Ill pre-clear standard consent language; share any redlines by Jun 22.
Ivy (Content): Ill draft the landing + blog outline and send to Sam for legal review by Jun 22 and to the team for final copy by Jun 25.
Owen (Sales Ops): Will mock the webhook integration in staging and demo Slack alert flow by Jul 7.
Sasha (Growth): good. please flag blockers in this thread. if logo or legal delays happen we may need to push the webinar by 1 week. :eyes:
